将图像分割为可编辑的前景层和背景层

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的图片。在可读背景前面有清晰主题的照片可以提供最清晰的分割。适用于：肖像、产品照片、人物、具有明显深度的场景

第 2 步：点击运行。无需提示。 Qwen Image Layered 读取场景并自行将其分开。默认为两层分割，一层前景，一层背景。

步骤 3. 下载图层。您会得到三个图像：原始图像、单独的背景以及单独的前景。在工作流程中预览它们，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · After Effects · Figma · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（两层·LoRA 加载速度·方形工作尺寸）几乎是任何图像的正确起点。想要更多作品吗？增加层数并步进层索引以拉出每一层。

概述

此工作流程采用平面图像，并使用 Qwen Image Layered 将其分割为单独的可编辑图层。您上传一张照片并返回三张图像：原始合成图像、背景本身和前景本身。背景重新填充到主题原来所在的位置，因此您可以重复使用干净的盘子，而不是有孔的图像。无需提示。速度 LoRA 保持快速运行，因此每个分段在大约 80 秒内返回。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用对象：创作者、视觉特效艺术家和产品团队，他们希望在 ComfyUI 中实现真正的分离层，而无需从头开始连接节点。不适用于：快速一次性剪裁。如果您想要的只是透明的 PNG，那么纯背景去除器会更快。当您想要可以继续编辑的图层时，这会赢得一席之地。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您要分割的图像。

  2. 打跑。无需提示。如果您想要超过两层，请先增加层数。

  3. 下载前景、背景和原图，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每次分裂大约在 80 秒内恢复。默认的两层分割会自动为您提供前景和背景。对于更多层，请增加计数并更改层索引以拉出每一层。需要了解的一个限制是：正面和背面清晰的图像可以清晰地分开，而没有明显深度的平面场景则更难让模型分开。

使用案例

背景交换。将拍摄对象从背景上抬起，然后放到新的背景上，无需手动遮罩。

产品和电子商务。通过一次上传将一张产品照片放在五个不同的背景上。

视觉特效和合成。获取真实图层以重新照明、模糊深度或在主题后面绘制。

概念和场景重建。将一个场景拆开，然后从前到后一点一点地重新组装。

Qwen Image Layered 可以分解什么？

o.en:
Split an image into editable foreground and background layers

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your image. A photo with a clear subject in front of a readable background gives the cleanest split. Works great with: portraits · product shots · characters · scenes with obvious depth

Step 2. Hit run. No prompt needed. Qwen Image Layered reads the scene and pulls it apart on its own. The default is a two-layer split, one foreground and one background.

Step 3. Download your layers. You get three images back: the original, the background on its own, and the foreground on its own. Preview them in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · After Effects · Figma · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (two layers · speed LoRA loaded · square working size) are the right starting point for almost any image. Want more pieces? Raise the layer count and step the layer index to pull each one out.

Overview

This workflow takes a flat image and splits it into separate, editable layers using Qwen Image Layered. You upload one photo and get three images back: the original composite, the background by itself, and the foreground by itself. The background comes back filled in where the subject used to be, so you get a clean plate to reuse, not an image with a hole in it. No prompt needed. A speed LoRA keeps runs quick, so each split comes back in about 80 seconds. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators, VFX artists, and product teams who want true separated layers in ComfyUI without wiring the nodes from scratch. Not for: a quick one-off cutout. A plain background remover is faster if all you want is a transparent PNG. This earns its place when you want layers you can keep editing.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload the image you want to split.

  2. Hit run. No prompt needed. Raise the layer count first if you want more than two layers.

  3. Download the foreground, background, and original, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each split comes back in about 80 seconds. The default two-layer split gives you a foreground and a background automatically. For more layers, raise the count and change the layer index to pull each one out. One limit to know: images with a clear front and back separate cleanly, while flat scenes with no obvious depth are harder for the model to pull apart.

Use Cases

Background Swaps. Lift the subject off its background and drop it onto a new one, no manual masking.

Product & E-commerce. Put one product shot on five different backdrops from a single upload.

VFX & Compositing. Get real layers to relight, blur for depth, or paint behind the subject.

Concept & Scene Rebuilds. Take a scene apart and reassemble it piece by piece, front to back.
